## Experiment results: prepack single-pass FILTER + narrowed agentic fallback

Setup: throwaway harness in worktree `filter-exp` @ origin/main (git-ignored `.expscratch/`; no src/rebar changes; nothing pushed to Gerrit). Filter = ONE Bedrock converse call (us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, temp 0, no tools) over ticket text + deterministic per-AC evidence packs (grep-at-ref for AC-named symbols/paths, file_impact slices, referencing commits via `git log --grep`, cited-test function listings; 6KB/AC cap; thin packs never synthesized). Contract: per AC, PASS-with-citations or ABSTAIN; FAIL forbidden (coerced). Fallback = the real agentic `verify_completion` (source=local, never signs) with the ticket's AC block REDUCED to the abstained ACs via a `unittest.mock.patch` of `rebar._reads.show_ticket`; verdict cache isolated per run by patching `completion_verdict_cache.cache_dir`. Control = same harness machinery, un-reduced ticket. Corpus: 3 real closed tickets (45c1 task 6 ACs, 3388 story 10 ACs, 0e68 epic 7 ACs + 14 children) + 3 in-harness adversarial variants with 1-2 ACs rewritten to reference symbols proven absent at ref.

### Metrics

| ticket (variant) | type | ACs | filter PASS / cov | false-PASS | filter tok(in/out) | fallback steps/tok(in)/wall | control steps/tok(in)/wall | combined vs control (in-tok) | verdict fb/ctl |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| barky-metalled-bettong (real) | task | 6 | 0 / 0% | **0** | 4766/310 | 17 / 832,111 / 103s | 17 / 841,510 / 103s | -1% | PASS/PASS |
| barky-metalled-bettong (adv) | task | 6 | 1 / 17% | **0** | 4863/338 | 19 / 877,032 / 91s | 15 / 691,226 / 88s | +28% | FAIL/FAIL |
| disparaged-parodistic-shrew (real) | story | 10 | 9 / 90% | **0** | 9951/1539 | 7 / 561,006 / 36s | 28 / 2,686,353 / 131s | -79% | PASS/PASS |
| disparaged-parodistic-shrew (adv) | story | 10 | 8 / 80% | **0** | 10367/1505 | 14 / 1,245,946 / 72s | 32 / 3,354,007 / 160s | -63% | FAIL/FAIL |
| outrageous-uncultured-wildebeast (real) | epic | 7 | 0 / 0% | **0** | 6109/412 | 32 / 1,723,537 / 225s | 37 / 2,274,302 / 261s | -24% | PASS/PASS |
| outrageous-uncultured-wildebeast (adv) | epic | 7 | 0 / 0% | **0** | 8305/562 | 55 / 3,350,295 / 280s | 35 / 1,852,161 / 277s | +81% | FAIL/FAIL |

TOTALS: combined 8.63M input tokens / 144 steps / 878s vs control 11.70M / 164 / 1020s (**-26% tokens**); real tickets only: 3.14M vs 5.80M (**-46%**). Total filter spend across all 6 calls: 49K tokens (~0.4% of control's agentic spend). Epic (0e68) reported with the with-children caveat: both arms traverse the 14 children identically; its +81%/-24% deltas are agentic run-to-run variance on IDENTICAL criteria sets (filter abstained all 7), not filter cost.

### Correctness (the survival criterion)
- **False-PASS count on adversarial unmet ACs: 0** — all 5 planted-unmet ACs (45c1: 2, 3388: 1, 0e68: 2) ABSTAINED at the filter and were FAILed by the fallback. Every real variant verified PASS/PASS; every adversarial variant FAIL/FAIL in both arms. False-positive rejection is impossible by construction and none occurred downstream of the filter on filter-PASSed ACs.
- No store writes beyond ticket comments; all 12 agentic runs source=local, signable=false; verdict caches isolated to per-run scratch dirs.

### Failure modes observed
1. **8000-char description admission cap** (deterministic fast-FAIL in verify_completion): killed the first corpus (11009ch and 10446ch tickets) and one adversarial edit that grew a 7998ch description to 8054. Adversarial edits must be length-neutral; any productized reducer must re-check the cap after reduction (reduction only ever shrinks, so it can also RESCUE an over-cap ticket).
2. **Coverage is bimodal by AC style, not ticket size**: ACs naming greppable artifacts (test functions, symbols, files) PASS from a static pack (3388: 90%); ACs asserting runtime outcomes ("suites pass green", "second pass emits zero updates", "lint clean") or store-side artifacts (ticket comments) rationally ABSTAIN (45c1, 0e68: 0%). Real-ticket coverage overall: 9/23 ACs = 39%.
3. **Filter coverage is context-sensitive**: 45c1 AC5 (commit-trailer AC, genuinely met, identical evidence pack) ABSTAINED in the real variant but PASSed in the adversarial variant — same pack, different surrounding ticket text. Temp-0 does not make the judgment stable across contexts.
4. **Agentic verifier variance dominates small deltas**: on identical criteria sets the agentic arm varied 35↔55 steps and in one 0e68-adv fallback run FAILed 2 genuinely-met ACs alongside the 2 planted ones (agentic false-FAILs — the exact pathology the operator predicted for pure single-pass, still present at low rate in the agentic verifier itself). Cost comparisons need variance-aware interpretation; ±30% single-run deltas are noise.
5. Prepack quality is the whole game: the first pack build (backtick tokens only) produced 100% abstention; adding identifier/path extraction + cited-test function listings unlocked 3388's 90%. Never-synthesize held throughout.

### Verdict: GO (conditional)
Filter+fallback beats pure-agentic on cost **with zero false PASSes**: -26% tokens overall, -46% on the real (all-met) corpus, and the filter's own cost is negligible (~0.4%), so the worst case is cost-neutral-within-variance while the best case (test-citing AC styles, exactly what the plan-review gate pushes authors toward) is a 60-80% saving. Recommend productizing as an optional pre-filter stage in verify_completion with: (a) the PASS/ABSTAIN-only contract enforced at the schema level, (b) the existing criteria-reduction seam (AC-block rewrite at ticket load) as the narrowing mechanism — it worked cleanly including epic child traversal and auto-narrowed the step budget, (c) filter-PASSed ACs recorded with their citations in the verdict for auditability, (d) coverage telemetry per AC style to decide when the filter call is worth making (skip it for tickets whose ACs are all runtime-outcome style). The residual risk to watch in production is not the filter (0 false PASSes here) but agentic false-FAIL variance, which this design narrows but does not remove.

(Full harness, packs, per-run usage JSONL and verdicts live in the filter-exp worktree's .expscratch/; experiment ticket: fabulous-lowborn-guanaco / 901b-676a-01c9-45fd.)
